items.q: it was a kind of a place where it was owned and run-undoubtedly Capone --owned that spot---

ctx.x: You do the very same thing today. But, I remember, it was a kind of a place where it was owned and run-undoubtedly Capone --owned that spot--- and he had this guy Fogarty who was the manager who ran the place.
